digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / rich text codec
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ's local dedup key is computed via markdown round-trip normalization (AdfCodec.normalize_outbound) while the Jira-side key is computed via plain-text normalization (adf_to_text), causing asymmetric escaping of markdown-active characters and autolink rewriting

The send path encodes a decorated comment body (with HTML comment marker), causing markdown_to_adf's content-preservation fallback to degrade the document to plain text encoding, while the local key round-trips the undecorated body through rich markdown encoding, producing a mismatch

An in-limit markdown comment with escaped characters (e.g., `[link](<http://x>)` after local normalization vs `[link](http://x)` in landed wire) fails dedup matching and re-emits as a duplicate mutation despite being already landed
The fix derives both dedup keys from the same decode by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate + fit + encode) and normalizing it with the same decoder used on the fetched Jira side
Tests verify that markdown comments under cloud cutover produce matching dedup keys and no duplicate mutations while genuinely new comments are still emitted
